```python
def similar_elements(list1, list2):
```

```python
def similar_elements(seq1, seq2):
    """Return a list of elements that appear in both seq1 and seq2."""
    # Convert the second sequence to a set for O(1) membership checks
    set2 = set(seq2)
    # Keep elements from seq1 that are also in seq2
    return [item for item in seq1 if item in set2]

# Provided tests
assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6),(5, 7, 4, 10))) == set((4, 5))
assert set(similar_elements((1, 2, 3, 4),(5, 4, 3, 7))) == set((3, 4))
```
